cases.given: The defect is local and the surrounding argument is correct.
cases.expect: Freezes both paragraphs, replaces only the overstated clause with source-supported wording, and checks both transitions and citation fit. Result: The unsupported claim is removed with no unrelated semantic change.
cases.reject: Omitting the mechanism or instead doing this: Reframe the whole section or add new evidence claims.

cases.given: the artifact architecture is globally wrong
cases.expect: Remain inactive; do not begin the package-specific first step: Identify the exact failed criterion and the smallest text, field, rule, or code unit causing it.
cases.reject: Activating Micro-Repair solely because its name appears relevant

cases.given: Do not preserve a frozen neighbor if it is proven part of the defect; explicitly widen the window instead.
cases.expect: Honor the conflict rule and preserve this invariant: name the defect before patching
cases.reject: Silently violating the stated precedence for Micro-Repair

cases.expect: Stop, narrow, abstain, or escalate while preserving: smallest-fault localization
cases.reject: Claiming a successful Micro-Repair result past this boundary

cases.given: a capable host can compress the workflow
One local unit fails while its neighbors pass.
cases.expect: The skill freezes passing neighbors, changes the minimum atoms, checks boundaries, and escalates if the defect proves systemic.
cases.reject: The skill rewrites the section for general improvement or applies repeated local patches to broken architecture.
